name: Catholics and Cappuccinos
overview: EWTN’s newest podcast hosted by Siobhan Fallon Hogan (SNL, Forrest Gump, Men in Black, Holes, New in Town, Seinfeld) as she interviews Catholic actors, singers, writers, and religious figures. Fallon Hogan engages with her guests using humor to find out how their Catholic faith has impacted their careers and vocations. Guests will include Jonathan Roumie (The Chosen), Patricia Heaton (Everybody Loves Raymond), Cathy Moriarty (Raging Bull), Federico Castelluccio (The Sopranos), Sister Mary Gabriel, Father Michael Duffy and many more.
